bio: Located just a few steps from the city’s historic Alcazaba, and standing above some of Mérida’s Roman remains visible through a glass floor, this restaurant is definitely worth considering for tapas, a meal or just a drink given the pleasant Roof Bar on the first floor. The cuisine here, including a good selection of Joselito-branded starters and select grilled meats, also features two tasting menus (4 and 8 courses), the longer of the two with a wine-pairing option....
